svg.title: Four Checks Before Vehicle Release
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutory-risk-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Vehicle Release; subtitle: A sequential decision path: every affirmative result advances; every failed check holds release.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The four nodes are sequential predicates, not numerical risk scores. Numeric values indicate reading order. California and New York City are concrete jurisdiction examples; apply the actual operating jurisdiction, service category, and airport rules.; caption: Release only after all four evidence sets are complete. Correct missing authority, coverage, screening, or contract terms before handover; a platform account does not replace carrier authority, insurer acceptance, or airport permission.; stages: label: Coverage matches every use state; value: Yes: advance; no: hold release until endorsements are verified; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map off-app rental use and rideshare Periods 1, 2, and 3 to actual policy language and named insureds. California Public Utilities Code section 5433 governs specified TNC coverage periods; commercial livery use needs its own applicable coverage analysis.; label: Authority matches service and location; value: Yes: advance; no: remove the prohibited operating assignment; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check California charter-party authority under Public Utilities Code section 5371 where applicable, or NYC TLC driver, vehicle, and base requirements for the relevant service. Verify airport permissions separately; TCP and TLC credentials are not nationwide substitutes.; label: Screening has a documented lawful basis; value: Yes: advance; no: stop report ordering and driver assignment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Establish a permissible consumer-report purpose under 15 U.S.C. 1681b and protect motor-vehicle information under 18 U.S.C. 2721. Use employment-specific disclosure and pre-adverse procedures when applicable; apply 15 U.S.C. 1681m adverse-action notices as required.; label: Contract and immobilizer controls are safe; value: Yes: release vehicle; no: correct terms or disable remote immobilization; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use enacted state UCC Article 2A and applicable rental statutes to review lease disclosures, toll fees, and remedies. Validate state immobilizer restrictions and insurer terms; permit no remote engine shutdown, and require verified stationary, unoccupied status plus human review for any permitted starter inhibition.

rect.title: label: Coverage matches every use state; value: Yes: advance; no: hold release until endorsements are verified; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map off-app rental use and rideshare Periods 1, 2, and 3 to actual policy language and named insureds. California Public Utilities Code section 5433 governs specified TNC coverage periods; commercial livery use needs its own applicable coverage analysis.

Verify airport permissions separately; TCP and TLC credentials are not nationwide substitutes.

Use employment-specific disclosure and pre-adverse procedures when applicable; apply 15 U.S.C. 1681m adverse-action notices as required.
